## JagDroid v0.43 (experimental)

**Play your own music through the Jaguar CD's VLM visualiser.**

- New **Music (VLM)** button in the library: pick any audio file Android can decode (MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC, OGG…). JagDroid converts it to a CD audio track and starts the Jaguar CD BIOS player with it. Press Play (B), then choose **VLM** for the Virtual Light Machine.
- Needs the Jaguar CD BIOS set in Settings (not included).
- Emulation: the CD unit now provides subcode Q data (track, time, disc position) and its interrupt, so the BIOS player's clock, track number and VLM work.
